decisions.reason: As a flagship cloud transactional email service shown on the home page and central to the firm's multichannel direction, it is an option worth exercising further, and the incremental cost of keeping it on proprietary infrastructure is low.

Managed capture has a dedicated page and a named customer reference, positive evidence that its value is materializing in document workflows, so further commitment rather than abandonment is justified.
Email and fax conversion builds on the firm's core fax and email infrastructure, so it costs little to keep, and demand persists among regulated German customers who still rely on fax.
Fax delivery optimization is a cheap feature embedded in an established service, so keeping the option open costs little even though fax demand is declining over the long term.
Sandbox threat protection addresses growing security demand within the email security suite, and unlike the dropped multi-engine scanner it remains strategically relevant at a low marginal cost.
